paper_title: Using the Sun and the Moon as Source masses and the Earth's Rotation as a Modulation to Search for Exotic Spin-Dependent Interactions at Astronomical Distances
coupling_convention: dimensionless product g_S^N*g_P^n; mass in eV converted from interaction range via m=hbar*c/lambda (hbar*c=1.973e-7 eV*m)
notes: Paper derives limits on exotic spin-dependent interactions using Sun/Moon as sources. Primary scalar-pseudoscalar (SP) result g_S^N*g_P^n < 1.6e-35 (95% C.L.) for lambda > 1e12 m (mass < ~2e-19 eV), spanning ranges 2e10 to 1e14 m. This maps to MonopoleDipole (g_s*g_p product). Only one explicit numeric value given in text; plots (Figs 2-4) show lambda-dependent curves not readable numerically. Paper also reports VA (g_V^N*g_A^n < 7.1e-59) and AA (g_A^N*g_A^n < 8.1e-31) couplings which are different (velocity-dependent) types.
